1513057.steps:
1.Setup a test bed as follow:
  PC----DUT----FTP Server
  2.Go to Log->Automation, Enable "Send Log to FTP", All configurations are correct
  3.Make FTP Server in PASS Model
  4. Enable packet monitor and trigger DUT to send log automation to server.
1513057.title: When FTP Server is in PASS Model
1513057.description:
Original ID: Integrity-004
Original Title: When FTP Server is in PASS Model
Original Description:
1513057.result:
In captured packets, FTP connection is established. Log will be saved in correct dirctory on server and
  inforamtion is correct

1513062.steps:

1513046.steps:
1.Setup a test bed as follow:
  PC----DUT----FTP Server
  2.Go to Log->Automation, Enable "Send Log to FTP", set correct FTP Server adddress and other configurations are correct
  3. Enable packet monitor and trigger DUT to send log automation to server. 4. Check packets captured. DUT can establish FTP connection with Server successfully and server can receive log
  5.Try to input incorrect value into FTP Server address

  Incorrect value will be prohibited and alert

1513043.steps:

  2.Go to Log->Automation, Enable "Send Log to FTP", All configurations are correct
  3. Trigger DUT to send log automation to server. Check the log entries on the server
  4.After about 5 minutes, trigger DUT to send log automation to server 5.Check log again and compare new added entries on Server with log enties on the GUI

Original ID: Function-021

Original Description:
1513043.result: Same log entries only will be sent to Server once and new added entries should be the same on Server and GUI
